title: Assistant Vice President- AI Security Engineering
description:
* Job Description: Demonstrate ability to lead secure AI engineering at enterprise and multi-client scale
* Strong balance of technical depth, risk judgment, and executive communication
* Proven effectiveness operating in global, regulated, client-delivery environments
* Credibility with both deeply technical teams and non-technical executive stakeholders

  

* Responsibilities: Define and lead the Secure AI Engineering practice across enterprise and client-delivered AI solutions.
* Establish secure-by-design standards, guardrails, and engineering controls for ML, GenAI, LLM, RAG, and Agentic AI systems
* Translate regulatory and risk requirements into practical engineering standards aligned with business outcomes.
* Oversee security architecture for the end-to-end AI lifecycle—data ingestion, training, fine-tuning, model management, inference, APIs, integrations, and infrastructure.
* Ensure protection against advanced AI threats including data poisoning, model theft, prompt injection, inference attacks, agent misuse, hallucination exploitation, and supply-chain compromise.
* Drive adoption of secure reference architectures, reusable components, and hardened AI pipelines across delivery teams.
* Embed security controls into CI/CD, MLOps, and LLMOps pipelines to enable scale without friction.
* Partner with cyber security and IR teams on AI-related incident preparedness, response, and post-incident improvements
* Client Advisory & External Engagement
* Act as a trusted advisor to business and clients on secure AI architecture, risk posture, and regulatory readiness.
* Lead or support AI security reviews, architecture assessments, and risk discussions for strategic clients.
* Build strong internal capability in secure AI engineering and adversarial ML awareness. solutions etc.

  

Qualifications: Masters DegBachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Cyber Security, AI/ML, Data Science, or related field

10–15+ years of experience in cyber security, secure architecture, or platform engineering, with 3+ years focused on Agentic, AI/ML or GenAI environments

Strong hands-on understanding of cloud-based AI platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP or equivalent)

Experience or strong working knowledge of AI governance, privacy, and MLOps/LLMOps tooling (e.g., Credo.ai, Priva Sapien, model registries and monitoring tools)

Deep knowledge of Secure AI & adversarial ML, Privacy-by-design and data protection, Secure MLOps / LLMOps practices

Familiarity with frameworks and regulations such as NIST AI RMF, NIST CSF, ISO/IEC standards, Emerging global AI regulations (US, EU, sector-specific)

Experience supporting clients in highly regulated industries strongly preferred (preferred) 14 Years

title: Senior Data Engineering Analyst
description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**

**Primary Responsibilities:**

* Data Engineering & Pipeline Development
  + Design, develop, and maintain scalable data pipelines and ETL/ELT processes supporting batch and streaming workloads
  + Build and optimize data ingestion frameworks using technologies such as Apache Spark, Kafka, and cloud-native services
  + Integrate data from multiple internal and external source systems while ensuring data quality, consistency, and governance
  + Develop and maintain data orchestration workflows to ensure reliable delivery of business-critical datasets
* Data Architecture & Modeling
  + Design and optimize data warehouses, data lakes, and lakehouse architectures
  + Build scalable and efficient data models supporting enterprise reporting, analytics, and AI/ML use cases
  + Work with platforms such as Snowflake, Delta Lake, Apache Iceberg, and cloud-based data ecosystems
  + Define and maintain data contracts, metadata standards, and lineage frameworks
* Data Security, Governance & Compliance
  + Design secure and compliant data pipelines incorporating encryption, IAM, RBAC, audit logging, and access controls
  + Implement data classification, masking, tokenization, and lineage solutions for sensitive healthcare data including PII and PHI
  + Support adherence to HIPAA, HITRUST, SOC 2, and enterprise security requirements
  + Contribute to audit readiness by maintaining controls documentation, access reviews, lineage records, and compliance evidence
* Data Reliability & Observability
  + Own data quality, observability, monitoring, and reliability for assigned business domains
  + Establish and monitor SLAs, data validation checks, and alerting mechanisms
  + Troubleshoot production issues, optimize performance, and ensure platform stability
  + Drive best practices around data testing, monitoring, and operational excellence
* Cloud & Platform Engineering
  + Support and enhance modern cloud-based data platforms, with a strong preference for AWS technologies
  + Implement CI/CD pipelines, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), and automated deployment practices
  + Optimize infrastructure utilization through right-sizing, auto-scaling, partitioning, clustering, and cost-management strategies
  + Contribute to platform automation and engineering process improvements
* Analytics & AI Enablement
  + Collaborate with Analytics, BI, and Data Science teams to enable reporting, advanced analytics, machine learning, and AI solutions
  + Develop feature stores and ML-ready datasets for predictive modeling initiatives
  + Ensure data accessibility, consistency, and reliability for downstream analytical applications
* Documentation & Leadership
  + Create and maintain technical documentation, architecture diagrams, schemas, and operational procedures
  + Document end-to-end data lineage, governance frameworks, and engineering standards
  + Mentor Associate and Junior Data Engineers, promoting engineering best practices and knowledge sharing
  + Stay current with emerging technologies, cloud innovations, security standards, and modern data engineering methodologies
* Comply with all applicable Company policies, procedures, and business directives, changes including those relating to work location, team assignments, work schedules, and flexible work arrangements

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Engineering, Engineering, or a related field
* 4+ years of experience in Data Engineering, Data Platform Engineering, or related areas
* Solid experience building and maintaining ETL/ELT pipelines and large-scale data processing systems
* Hands-on experience with Apache Spark and distributed data processing frameworks
* Experience working with Kafka or other streaming technologies
* Experience with Snowflake, Delta Lake, Apache Iceberg, or similar cloud data platforms
* Solid knowledge of data warehousing and lakehouse architectures
* Solid understanding of data governance, metadata management, and data lineage concepts
* Familiarity with CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, and DevOps practices
* Proficiency in SQL and Python
* Proven excellent analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills
* Proven solid communication and stakeholder management capabilities

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Hands-on experience with AWS services such as S3, Glue, EMR, Lambda, Redshift, IAM, KMS, and CloudWatch
* Experience implementing HIPAA, HITRUST, SOC2, or other regulated industry compliance requirements
* Experience supporting AI, Machine Learning, and Data Science workloads
* Experience with Terraform, Kubernetes, Docker, and modern cloud-native architectures
* Knowledge of data security practices including encryption, tokenization, data masking, and access management
* Familiarity with feature stores, MLOps, and ML data pipelines
* Proven exposure to vulnerability management tools such as Snyk, Wiz, Trivy, or equivalent

*At UnitedHealth Group, our mission is to help people live healthier lives and make the health system work better for everyone. We believe everyone-of every race, gender, sexuality, age, location and income-deserves the opportunity to live their healthiest life. Today, however, there are still far too many barriers to good health which are disproportionately experienced by people of color, historically marginalized groups and those with lower incomes. We are committed to mitigating our impact on the environment and enabling and delivering equitable care that addresses health disparities and improves health outcomes - an enterprise priority reflected in our mission.*

title: Track Manager (Support & Operations)
description:
Track Manager (Support & Operations)

Gautam Buddha Nagar, Uttar Pradesh

**Job Summary**
---------------

**Applied AI Technologist**

*(AI Experience Technologist)*

**About the role**
==================

We're looking for an Applied AI Technologist who can turn a customer's business problem into a working, production-ready AI solution. You'll work at the point where customer conversations and hands-on building meet. You'll understand what the customer needs, picture the end state, build it quickly with AI-assisted development, and make sure it holds up in a real enterprise environment.

This is a builder role for someone with sound engineering judgment. Vibe coding lets you move fast, and your fundamentals decide what is good enough to ship.

Experience : 3 to 10 years

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**Key responsibilities**
========================

**Customer and requirements**
-----------------------------

* Work directly with customers to understand their business problems, clarify vague requirements, and turn them into clear solution outcomes.
* Picture the end state for customers and end users, and show it early with prototypes, mockups and demos.
* Get up to speed quickly on new domains and customer contexts, and know when to bring in specialists.
* Explain solutions, trade-offs and risks clearly to both business and technical stakeholders.

**Building with AI**
--------------------

* Design and build solutions quickly with AI-assisted development tools (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot).
* Guide LLMs precisely, with structured prompting, context engineering and step-by-step iteration, so the output is accurate and consistent.
* Build LLM-powered applications, including agentic workflows, RAG pipelines and tool or function-calling integrations where relevant.
* Design user experiences that are intuitive, useful and fit how end users actually work.

**Engineering quality and production readiness**
------------------------------------------------

* Review, test, debug and harden AI-generated code. Understand what the AI produced before shipping it, and reject what doesn't meet the bar.
* Take solutions from prototype to production: deployment, integration with customer systems (APIs, identity, data sources) and maintainable handover.
* Design evaluations, test cases and guardrails to measure and improve LLM output quality, reliability and safety.
* Apply security, data-privacy and responsible-AI practices in every solution, especially when handling customer data.

**Skill Requirements**
----------------------

**Required skills and experience**
==================================

* **Programming:** Strong hands-on experience in Python and/or front-end (React, JavaScript/TypeScript) or back-end development, with solid software engineering fundamentals: code structure, testing, debugging, version control and basic architecture.
* **AI-assisted development:** Expert in vibe-coding workflows. Can break problems into steps, steer AI agents effectively, and review output critically.
* **Prompting and LLM steering:** Deep expertise in prompt design, including system prompts, few-shot examples, reasoning techniques, structured outputs, tool use and context management.
* **LLM evaluation:** Experience defining success criteria, building test sets and evaluating model output systematically.
* **Deployment and integration:** Working knowledge of at least one cloud platform (Azure, AWS or GCP), APIs, containers or serverless, and CI/CD basics.
* **Security and responsible AI:** Understanding of data privacy, PII handling, access control, prompt-injection risks and enterprise compliance.
* **Communication:** Excellent written and spoken English. Can explain complex ideas clearly and concisely, and present with confidence to customers.
* **Mindset:** Learns fast, takes ownership of outcomes, and knows what AI should and shouldn't be used to build.

**Nice to have**
================

* Experience with agentic frameworks (e.g., LangGraph, CrewAI, Semantic Kernel, MCP) or enterprise AI platforms (Azure AI Foundry, Copilot Studio, AWS Bedrock, Vertex AI).
* Experience in a customer-facing, consulting or pre-sales role.
* A background in UX, design thinking or product management.
* A portfolio of AI solutions, demos or open-source work that you've built and deployed.

**Other Requirements**
----------------------

**Selection process**
=====================

* **Screening conversation:** background, communication and customer orientation.

* **Live build exercise (90–120 minutes):** Candidates get a deliberately vague customer brief. They are expected to:

* + ask questions to clarify the requirement
  + build a working solution using AI tools of their choice
  + walk through what they built and what they would fix, secure or test before production.

* **Customer-scenario discussion:** role-play presenting the solution to a business stakeholder.

title: Autonomous Network Consulting Principal
description:
**Join our Team**
-----------------

**About this Opportunity**

We are seeking a highly experienced consulting leader to join Ericsson’s Global Consulting organization, within the Network and BSS/OSS Transformation Consulting practice. This role requires a respected industry professional with deep expertise in Autonomous Networking as defined by TM Forum, 3GPP, and core AN foundational capabilities.

You think from the client’s perspective, thrive on solving complex problems, and excel at winning and delivering consulting projects. You are confident, insightful, and capable of guiding clients through difficult decisions. Beyond strong technical skills, you can model business value, redesign telecom operational processes, and quantify the impact of automation and autonomy. You lead teams on new, unsolved problems tackling network-scale challenges. You have delivered significant OSS/BSS transformation programs as the delivery lead and are confident in leading complex transformations. Clients trust you, remember you, and rely on your vendor‑agnostic guidance.

As a Principal Consultant, you will lead and oversee consulting engagements, mentor experienced consultants, and take a leading role in business development through developing and managing proposals, presentations, and opportunity identification. Ericsson follows an “everyone sells” culture—consultants shape and evolve offerings aligned to market trends, from AN today to topics like 6G tomorrow.

The role is global and highly collaborative, involving close work with Ericsson teams across multiple business units and with clients worldwide. Some assignments may support internal solution development or value-argumentation initiatives. International travel at short notice is expected (typically 50–75% during normal conditions).

**What You Will Do**

**Autonomous Networks Transformation Consulting**

  

* Prior to client investment
  + Lead advisory projects to define AN vision and strategy, prioritise operational flows, assess AN capabilities, assess AN maturity, Define target architectural blueprints, define Target operating models and justify investments
* Post client investment
  + Realize AN use-cases and solution implementation through Operating model transformation and value realization and assurance

**Technology**

  

* Bring deep knowledge of industry standards and architectures for mobile networks.
* Apply hands-on experience with AN foundational capabilities: data, inventory, cloud-native environments, service orchestration, AI/ML models and MLOps, intent-based operations, service management, agentic AI, and telecom operational processes.
* Demonstrate proven experience in AI-driven or transformation consulting, with a strong understanding of Agentic AI.
* Leverage familiarity with TM Forum frameworks (AN, eTOM, SID, TAM), 3GPP standards, and ITIL practices.
* Utilize experience with automation technologies such as SMO, DevOps, Cloud-Native orchestration, Ansible, and RPA.

**What You Will Bring**

**Required Experience - min 10 years**

* 5+ years of experience in network automation and transformation, including 7+ years in consulting roles involving sales and delivery of transformation programs.
* Strong industry knowledge with a deep understanding of network autonomy concepts and evolution.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to influence and engage senior-level stakeholders.
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering required; a Master’s in Engineering or Business is a strong advantage.

**All academic credentials must be from recognized and accredited institutions and are further subject to verification**

title: Universal Banker Leader-Ludhiana
description:
**Job Description – Universal Banker Leader (New Branch)\-Ludhiana** **Some careers open more doors than others.**


If you’re looking for a career that will unlock new opportunities, join HSBC and experience the possibilities. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.


**Business Descriptor**


Within International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB), we serve 41 million customers globally, including 6\.7 million who are international, from retail customers to ultra high net worth individuals and their families. We help our customers to take care of their day\-to\-day finances and to manage, protect and grow their wealth. Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to deliver on HSBC’s purpose of opening up a world of opportunity by providing our customers with borderless banking and world\-class wealth management through best\-in\-class, mobile\-first capabilities and exceptional people. Our key areas of operations include Retail Banking and Wealth Management, Asset Management, Global Private Banking and Insurance.

  

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join the International Wealth and Premier Banking \- Ludhiana Branch  

**Job Introduction**  

International Wealth and Premier Banking is executing a multiyear growth strategy, pivoted on positioning as a global bank, committed to the long\-term India growth story, and bringing to India, its full scale of global capabilities. The Business is poised for growth and is currently also adding 20 more branches in phases to its existing fleet of 26 branches.  

IWPB is looking for a proactive and customer focused Universal Banker Leader (UB \- Customer Service Manager) to lead all daily operations at the Ludhiana branch.

title: System Test Specialist - IEC 61850
description:
The System Testing Engineer is a specialist\-level individual contributor responsible for executing and driving advanced system testing activities for substation automation and protection systems. This role centers on IEC 61850 (Edition 2\.1\), top\-down engineering, and multi\-vendor relay interoperability, with a modern mandate to integrate AI\-agentic workflows into the testing lifecycle.
**Job Description**
===================


**Core Focus: Test Strategy \& Execution**
------------------------------------------


* **Test Case Design:** Architect comprehensive, high\-coverage test suites for complex protection and control logic.
* **Automation Scripting:** Develop and maintain robust automation scripts to enhance test cycle speed and consistency.
* **Defect Tracking:** Perform rigorous defect lifecycle management, from identification and root cause analysis to final validation.

**AI\-Driven Testing Workflow \& Skills**
-----------------------------------------


* **Requirements to Tests:** Generate accurate test cases and automation scripts directly from technical requirements using AI\-powered tools.
* **Validation:** Review and validate AI\-generated automation scripts for accuracy, maintainability, and standard compliance.
* **Defect Intelligence:** Utilize AI\-driven tools for automated defect triage, trend analysis, and comprehensive summarization of complex system issues.
* **Exploratory Testing:** Apply advanced prompt engineering techniques to conduct AI\-guided exploratory testing to uncover edge\-case defects.

**Technical Responsibilities**
------------------------------


* **Troubleshooting:** Serve as the Single Point of Contact (SPOC) for IEC 61850 inquiries. Perform deep\-dive analysis of communication logs (GOOSE, MMS, SV) and relay event records to resolve multi\-vendor integration challenges.
* **Technical Collaboration:** Review communication matrices and SCL configurations to identify design gaps early.
* **Documentation:** Maintain detailed, audit\-ready test evidence and documentation for project certification and delivery.

**Required Skills and Experience**
----------------------------------


* **Domain Expertise:** 3 to 6 years deep hands\-on experience with **IEC 61850 (Edition 2 \& 2\.1\)** and substation automation/protection systems.
* **Integration Skills:** Proven experience in **testing and troubleshooting systems** with multi\-vendor **IEDs/Relays**.
* **Automation \& Scripting:** Proficiency in **scripting** (Python, Shell, or similar) and experience with test automation frameworks.
* **AI Competency:** Demonstrated ability to apply AI based tools for test design, script generation, and defect analysis. Strong command of prompt engineering to drive technical workflows.
* **Analytical Ability:** Exceptional skill in log analysis, protocol trace interpretation, and root\-cause identification.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------


* Background in power systems, protection and control, or digital substation engineering.
* Experience with SCL engineering and IEC 61850 system configuration tools.
* Experience managing complex test environments and high\-volume defect tracking in a specialist capacity.

**Additional Information**
==========================


**Relocation Assistance Provided:** Yes

commissioning

clients, and customers

site

--------------------



To be a driven business analyst who can work on complex Analytical problems and help the customer in better business decision making especially in the area of pharma/life sciences (domain).


**Job Responsibilities**
------------------------


**Role Overview**



The Snowflake Developer is responsible for building and optimizing data pipelines and analytical datasets within a Snowflake\-based data lakehouse. This role also includes leveraging **Snowflake Cortex** to enable AI\-driven data transformations, natural language processing, and intelligent data applications directly within the data platform.



**Key Responsibilities**


**1\. Data Ingestion \& Integration**


* Develop and maintain scalable data ingestion pipelines (batch and near real\-time).
* Load data from databases, APIs, files, and streaming systems into Snowflake.
* Handle structured and semi\-structured data (JSON, Parquet, Avro, CSV).
* Integrate Snowflake with cloud storage platforms (S3, Azure Data Lake, GCS).


**2\. Data Transformation (ELT)**


* Build ELT pipelines using Snowflake SQL and native features (Streams, Tasks, Dynamic Tables).
* Implement transformations across Bronze, Silver, and Gold layers.
* Use tools like dbt for modular, reusable, and testable transformations.


**3\. Snowflake Cortex \& AI Enablement**


* Leverage **Snowflake Cortex** functions within SQL for AI\-powered transformations.
* Implement use cases such as:
* + Text summarization of large datasets (logs, documents)
	+ Sentiment analysis and classification
	+ Natural language enrichment of datasets
* Work with vector embeddings and similarity search for semantic use cases.
* Assist in building AI\-ready datasets for downstream analytics and ML.
* Collaborate with data scientists to integrate AI/ML logic into Snowflake pipelines.
* Support simple **prompt engineering** within Cortex functions for optimized outputs.


**4\. Data Modeling**


* Design and implement analytical data models (star schema, snowflake schema).
* Build fact and dimension tables optimized for BI and AI use cases.
* Ensure datasets are structured for both analytics and AI consumption.


**5\. Performance \& Cost Optimization**


* Optimize SQL queries and Snowflake workloads.
* Use clustering, caching, and efficient compute strategies.
* Monitor warehouse usage and control costs, including Cortex consumption.


**6\. Data Quality \& Validation**


* Implement data validation checks and quality frameworks.
* Ensure accuracy, completeness, and consistency of data.
* Debug and resolve pipeline and data issues.


**7\. Security \& Governance**


* Apply RBAC, masking policies, and row\-level security.
* Ensure compliance with data governance and privacy standards.
* Maintain proper documentation and lineage for datasets.


**8\. Collaboration \& Agile Delivery**


* Work with architects, analysts, and AI/ML teams.
* Translate business and AI use cases into technical implementations.
* Participate in Agile development processes.
